front: CTC path probability and transcript probability

back: Merge consecutive repeats, then delete blanks (a a _ a b b _ c becomes a a b c).
Allows 'no emission' at a frame and separates equal consecutive labels such as the double l in 'hello'.
$O(T\cdot U)$; impossible (probability 0) when $T<U+$ number of adjacent equal target pairs.
Frames are predicted independently, so CTC has no internal language model; fix with an external LM in beam search.
Greedy takes the best path; prefix beam search tracks $p_b$ and $p_{nb}$ per prefix and merges paths with the same prefix, approximating the best transcript.
Encoder over audio, prediction network over past labels, joiner producing a distribution over $V+1$ symbols; lattice $T\times(U+1)\times(V+1)$.
$P(y|x)=\prod_uP(y_u|y_{<u},\mathrm{Enc}(x))$ with cross-attention; no alignment constraint, autoregressive.
30 s log-mel (80, 3000), stride-2 conv gives 1500 positions of 20 ms; task chosen by special tokens in the decoder prompt.
Hallucination on silence (use VAD), cascading errors from conditioning on previous text, padded short clips, wrong mel statistics.
$(S+D+I)/N$ over reference words; can exceed 1; normalise case/punctuation first; CER is the character version.
